jobs.description:
As a CE Driver, you'll manage regional trips starting from region Kortrijk.

You work independently: loading and unloading goods, checking transport documents, and staying in direct contact with planning and customers. 

Your days start early and you complete several trips a day. 

Looking for variety? Then this could be your next job. Apply quickly to find out if this is the right fit for you!

• Valid CE driver's license and Code 95

• Safety is your top priority

• You work independently and take responsibility

• Ready for physical work

• You speak fluent Dutch, French, or English

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

We are looking for experienced pharmaceutical professionals who want to actively contribute to the future of medicine. This is more than just a job, it is an opportunity to further develop your expertise and grow your career in a dynamic, mission-driven environment focused on patient impact.
 

If you already have experience in cleanroom operations, pharmaceutical manufacturing or chemical processes, or if you combine a relevant educational background with hands-on experience, we would very much like to hear from you.
 

Your role and responsibilities;
 
 
 
• Actively participate in aseptic and manual pharmaceutical manufacturing processes. 
 
• Work in cleanroom and laboratory environments in accordance with GMP standards. 
 
• Perform production activities in controlled environments (Grade A/B/C/D), including spiking, media exchanges, cell culture activities and freezing of therapeutic products. 
 
• Execute thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials and equipment. 
 
• Support transitions between production zones, ensuring compliance and continuity. 
 
 

This role is suited for you if you:
 

 
• Have relevant pharmaceutical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences.
 
• Have experience in a cleanroom, pharmaceutical, or chemical environment.
 
• Enjoy working in a structured environment and following procedures.
 
• Communicate fluently in English.
 
• Live near Zwijnaarde and can commute independently to the site.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!
 

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 
 

 
 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.
 

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.
 

What You’ll Do
 

 
• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
 
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
 
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
 
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
 
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients. 
 

Good to Know You’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:
 

 
• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
 
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
 
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
 
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.
 
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

jobs.occupation: Inside sales | German market | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company operating within the food sector. With a family-business mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and strong growth ambitions, they offer a fast-paced environment where initiative and results are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

•  Proactively identify and develop new business opportunities within the German market.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Manage the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing deals.
• Conduct commercial negotiations and follow up on sales opportunities.
• Expand the customer portfolio and strengthen market presence.
• Analyze sales performance and market trends.
• Report on sales activities and contribute to the overall sales strategy.

•  Fluent in German and English, knowledge of Dutch or additional languages is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development, or a commercial role.
• Strong commercial acumen and a results-oriented mindset.
• A true go-getter with the drive to open new doors and create opportunities.
• Confident communicator with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Affinity with the food industry is an advantage.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.

Producent van schoonmaakproducten

Interesse in deze vacature? Wij horen graag van je, contacteer ons op het nummer 056/26 52 10 of mail jouw CV naar menen@unique.be

Jobomschrijving

If you are ambitious, self-motivated, hardworking and a team player and interested in growing your career with an International FMCG business, please read through our job opportunity.

Your responsibilities are

• Improve efficiency of filling lines by developing, managing and introducing a variety of improvement actions with as objective to increase productivity and quality of the output of the filling lines. You make an analysis of production processes and report about waste in quality and efficiency.
• Solve critical issues by analyzing root causes on the short term and make proposals for solutions on the long term in order to guarantee and optimize filling production and this by engaging and motivating team members and let them gain autonomy in their job roles.
• Check continuously the filling production processes in terms of quality, input, output, safety and ergonomic circumstances
• Make proposals, together with the production team and the team coordinator, of technical improvements and guarantee that the improvements are implemented with as objective to improve efficiency, quality, lead time and to maintain cost leadership. You make sure the proposals are in line with the operational excellence strategy. You are responsible for the improvement projects, both technical and organizational, from A to Z.
• Act as back up of the filling production manager in day-to-day activities of the department.

Studies and working experience

• Industrial engineering degree without experience or bachelor with experience
• Experience in a production environment
• Experience in project management is an asset
Technical skills

• Good knowledge of Dutch
• Knowledge of English / French
• Knowledge of TPM / Lean / Operational Excellence
• Knowledge MES system
• Knowledge MS Office / Excel
Specific skills

• Analytic
• Innovative
• Communicative skill
• Setting of priorities
• Problem analysis

jobs.occupation: Senior Portfolio Manager - Brussels - Private Banking
jobs.description:
Our client is a specialised player within private banking and wealth management, supporting a defined professional client base with tailored investment solutions. Their offices in Brussels are easily accessible and offer a collaborative environment focused on expertise and long-term value creation.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage and monitor investment portfolios for high-net-worth clients
• Develop and implement investment strategies aligned with client objectives and risk profiles
• Work closely with relationship managers to support client advisory activities
• Conduct financial and market analyses to identify investment opportunities
• Participate in investment committees and contribute to strategic decisions
• Oversee portfolio performance, risk exposure and asset allocation
• Support the continuous development of investment processes and expertise

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Business Administration or a related field
• Minimum 7 years of experience in portfolio management, investments or private banking
• Fluent in Dutch, with a professional knowledge of English and/or French
• Strong understanding of financial markets, asset allocation and investment strategies
• Analytical, autonomous and detail-oriented in decision-making
• Effective communicator with a collaborative approach towards internal stakeholders

jobs.occupation: Investor Acquisition Manager - Investment Management Firm
jobs.description:
Our client is an international investment firm specializing in discretionary portfolio management for private and institutional investors. Active across Belgium and Luxembourg, the company benefits from a strong reputation and continued growth throughout European markets.

Jobomschrijving

• Contact and qualify high-net-worth prospects generated through marketing campaigns, and develop your own prospect opportunities
• Develop investor interest and schedule advisory meetings
• Conduct multiple discussions with prospects and guide them through the decision-making process until investment commitment
• Support clients throughout the account opening and funding process
• Achieve commercial targets in terms of outreach, meetings, and new client acquisition
• Develop your expertise in wealth management through a structured training program
• Collaborate closely with portfolio management and client service teams to deliver an outstanding client experience

• Degree in Finance, Economics, Business or equivalent professional experience
• Minimum 5 years of successful sales or business development experience within financial services
• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a professional command of English
• Proven track record in acquiring high-net-worth clients and generating new investment business
• Strong consultative selling skills and confidence discussing investment-related topics
• Entrepreneurial mindset, resilience and excellent relationship-building abilities
